question: What outcome does this contemplation produce for the practitioner?
premises: It brings quick accomplishment in relation to the two modes.
inference: Through this contemplation the practitioner becomes accomplished and quickly attains success.
uncertainties: The referent of tayoḥ (the two) is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: And thus the practitioner becomes accomplished; indeed, this brings quick accomplishment in regard to those two.
